title: Auto Refill & Medication Sync Fulfilment and Dispensing Matrix
content:
Where an Auto Refill & Medication Sync cycle is dispensed, how it may reach the patient, and at what speed a delivered cycle travels are fixed per program as follows.

| Program | Fulfilment methods offered | Delivery speed used for delivered cycles | Where cycles are dispensed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | store pickup; home delivery | none | the store holding the prescription |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | store pickup; home delivery | none | the store holding the prescription |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | store pickup; home delivery | none | the store holding the prescription |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | store pickup; home delivery | none | the store holding the prescription |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | store pickup; home delivery | same day | central fill |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | home delivery only | standard mail | central fill |

## Values used in the matrix

- **Fulfilment methods** are drawn from two values, store pickup and home delivery; a program offers one or both.
- **Delivery speed** is one of three values: none, standard mail or same day.
- **Dispensing location** is one of two values: the holding store (the store holding the prescription) or central fill.

## Points read from the matrix

- Store pickup is offered by every program except Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill, which offers home delivery only.
- Two programs dispense at central fill: Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging and Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill. The other four dispense at the holding store.
- The delivery speed listed as none belongs to the four holding-store programs; Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging lists same day and Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill lists standard mail.
